title: [3.0-beta9] Automation Disconnect pump entries 2/m?
symptom: In the Automation tab, when the loop has the 'Disconnect pump' case, a large number of 'Disconnected' and 'Loop disabled' lines appear, about 2 per minute. Also, in 'Suspend loop' mode, many 'Loop is disabled' lines appear.
cause: The automation log shows 'Loop disabled' every minute because automation rules are not processed when loop is disabled, and this is by design. Additionally, the loop runs every 1 minute but each rule has a minimum 5-minute limit before next run, and there are many triggers (data changes) leading to more frequent automation loop runs.
fix: No fix needed; behavior is by design. The maintainer explained that the frequent entries are expected due to the automation schedule and rule limits.
evidence_quote: if loop is disabled automation rules are not processed and 'Loop disabled' appear in automation log every minute (1 minute is automation schedule). this is by desing
